purpose: Codify how the Comms Hub is enforced, managed, maintained, operated, enhanced, and reconciled when activity happens outside the controlled path.

doctrine.operating_principle: GitHub/Pen is the handoff truth. Runtime receipts are the execution truth. Live endpoints are observed truth. A change is fully trusted only when these align.
enforcement: All work, code, assets, artifacts and comms changes require a GitHub/Pen receipt.
All runtime work requires a runtime receipt or failure receipt.
Publication feed changes require schema validation before deploy.
Unreceipted changes are classified OUT_OF_BAND_UNTRUSTED until reconciled.
Thread closure and runtime closure are separate states.
management: Every request carries an idempotency key, job type, owner or lane, asset manifest, acceptance criteria, expected receipt path, stale threshold and escalation action.
The Pen owns queue state after handoff.
Bridge or worker owns execution, validation and receipt writing.
Command Centre or evidence ledger should show latest health, receipt and drift state.
maintenance: Maintain a canonical publication manifest or comms registry.
Monitor root endpoint and feed endpoint.
Track deployment id and rollback target.
Scan for stale Pen jobs and missing receipts.
operation: Work is packaged and committed to the Pen.
GitHub receipt is posted back in-thread.
Thread closes as HANDOFF_COMPLETE unless runtime closure was explicitly requested in-thread.
Runtime receipt or failure receipt is written.
enhancement: New feed fields require schema versioning.
New deploy paths require deploy and rollback receipts.
No enhancement is REAL until receipt-backed.
outside_process: Manual Vercel deploys, feed edits, domain changes, env/config changes, source edits without deployment receipt, or deployment without source receipt are OUT_OF_BAND_UNTRUSTED.
Out-of-band changes must be detected, captured, compared to last known receipt, reconciled or rolled back, and recorded with a final classification.
Out-of-band does not mean bad. It means observed but not canonical until evidence exists.

tests_requested: Confirm this payload exists in GitHub/Pen.
Read the committed file back after write.
If runtime receipt is absent, classify runtime as PARTIAL_NOT_CLOSED and thread as HANDOFF_COMPLETE.

closure_classification.thread_state: HANDOFF_COMPLETE once commit receipt is posted back in chat
closure_classification.runtime_state: PARTIAL_NOT_CLOSED until runtime receipt or failure receipt exists
